Introduction

I:MOND is a South Korean independent girl group under their self-founded agency EMMP Company. They were formed by Be the max Entertainment and made their debut on June 4, 2024 with the single album "We Are Gravity".

On July 7, 2025 it was announced that Youngwon has departed from I:MOND after consultation with the agency due to personal reasons and various circumstances within the group.
